'''Werner Wilhelm Franke''' (31 January 1940 – 14 November 2022) was a German biologist and a professor of [[cell biology|cell]] and [[molecular biology]] at the [[German Cancer Research Center]] in [[Heidelberg]]. He was an anti-doping pioneer in Germany.

== Life ==
Franke was born in [[Paderborn]] on 31 January 1940.<ref name="FAZ1">{{cite news | title=Kurzbiographie Werner Franke: Wissenschaftler und Aufklärer | website=[[FAZ.NET]] | date=16 September 2005 | url=https://www.faz.net/aktuell/sport/kurzbiographie-werner-franke-wissenschaftler-und-aufklaerer-1252042.html | language=de | access-date=15 November 2022}}</ref> After completing high school (''[[Abitur]]'' at [[Gymnasium Theodorianum]]), he studied chemistry, biology and physics at the [[Ruprecht Karl University of Heidelberg|University of Heidelberg]].<ref name="CV" /> Following completion of his doctorate (Heidelberg) and [[habilitation]] ([[University of Freiburg|Freiburg]]) he became a university professor in Heidelberg and, at the same time, became the head of a department at the German Cancer Research Center.<ref name="CV" /> In 1982, Franke became the president of the European Cell Biology Organization (ECBO), a post he held until 1990.<ref name="CV" /> His main research field was the molecular characterization of the [[cytoskeleton]] in normal and transformed cells.<ref>[https://www.dkfz.de/de/helmholtz-zellbiologie/download/Franke-Profil-BioPro.pdf Werner Franke – Zellbiologe und Aufklärer], profile at BioPro. German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ), 2007.</ref> He was also a doping expert.<ref name="Hamburg 2022" />

Franke died on 14 November 2022 from an [[intracerebral hemorrhage]], at age 82.<ref name="Zeitung 2022">{{cite news | title=Provokant und kompromisslos: Werner Franke ist tot | website=[[Süddeutsche.de]] | date=15 November 2022 | url=https://www.sueddeutsche.de/sport/doping-provokant-und-kompromisslos-werner-franke-ist-tot-dpa.urn-newsml-dpa-com-20090101-221115-99-532792 | language=de | access-date=15 November 2022| last1=Zeitung | first1=Süddeutsche }}</ref><ref name="Hamburg 2022">{{cite web | title=Anti-Doping-Kämpfer Werner Franke gestorben | website=[[Hamburger Abendblatt]] | date=15 November 2022 | url=https://www.abendblatt.de/sport/article236922571/Anti-Doping-Kaempfer-Werner-Franke-gestorben.html | language=de | access-date=15 November 2022}}</ref>

===Drug abuse in sports===
Franke is considered to have been a leading expert in performance-enhancing drugs and one of the most ardent critics of drug abuse in sports. Together with his wife, [[Brigitte Berendonk]], once an Olympic [[discus throw]]er and [[shot put]]ter, he fought against drug abuse in sports. He assisted his wife in researching the 1991 book ''Doping: From Research to Deceit'', uncovering the systematic use of doping by [[German Democratic Republic|East German]] athletes.<ref name="www.ran.de 2022">{{cite web | title=Allgemein – Trauer um Doping-Experten Werner Franke | website=www.ran.de | date=15 November 2022 | url=https://www.ran.de/allgemein/news/trauer-um-doping-experten-werner-franke-161995 | language=de | access-date=15 November 2022}}</ref>

Franke defended [[cycle sport|cyclist]] [[Danilo Hondo]] after the banned substance [[Carphedon]] was found in his blood during the 2005 [[Vuelta a Murcia]].<ref name="RP ONLINE 2005">{{cite web | title=Rückendeckung: "Anti-Doping-Papst" wittert Unrecht im Fall Hondo | website=RP ONLINE | date=4 November 2005 | url=https://rp-online.de/sport/anti-doping-papst-wittert-unrecht-im-fall-hondo_aid-10939531 | language=de | access-date=15 November 2022}}</ref><ref name="Burkhardt 2011">{{cite news | last=Burkhardt | first=Markus | title=Dopingfahnder Franke kämpft für gesperrten Hondo | website=[[Die Welt]] | date=15 November 2011 | url=https://www.welt.de/print-welt/article179029/Dopingfahnder-Franke-kaempft-fuer-gesperrten-Hondo.html | language=de | access-date=15 November 2022}}</ref> Franke argued that the amount found in his blood was "laughably small" and that "you can only get this medication through certain channels in Russia or China, where it is used by the military and the space flight programs."<ref>{{cite web|url=http://autobus.cyclingnews.com/news.php?id=news/2005/nov05/nov05news|title= German doping expert defends Hondo|date=5 November 2005|accessdate=30 July 2007}}</ref>

During an interview on 3 August 2006 with German regional television channel {{ill|rheinmaintv|de}}, Franke claimed that cyclist [[Jan Ullrich]] purchased about €35,000 worth of doping products a year from [[Eufemiano Fuentes]] based on documents uncovered in the [[Operación Puerto doping case]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://uk.sports.yahoo.com/03082006/3/ullrich-spent-35-000-euros-year-drugs-claims-expert.html|title=Ullrich 'spent 35,000 euros' in a year on drugs claims expert|date=3 August 2006|accessdate=30 July 2007|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20070311115123/http://uk.sports.yahoo.com/03082006/3/ullrich-spent-35-000-euros-year-drugs-claims-expert.html|archivedate=11 March 2007}}</ref><ref name="Hövel 2007">{{cite web | last=Hövel | first=Jörg Auf dem | title=Jan Ullrich gegen den Dopingexperten Werner Franke | website=Telepolis | date=2 November 2007 | url=https://www.heise.de/tp/features/Jan-Ullrich-gegen-den-Dopingexperten-Werner-Franke-3415975.html | language=de | access-date=15 November 2022}}</ref> A German court imposed a [[gag order]] on Franke after it found there was not enough evidence to link Ullrich to doping.<ref name="DIE WELT 2011">{{cite news | title=RAD: Franke unterliegt Ullrich vor Gericht | website=[[Die Welt]] | date=15 November 2011 | url=https://www.welt.de/sport/article715820/Franke-unterliegt-Ullrich-vor-Gericht.html | language=de | access-date=15 November 2022}}</ref> However, that case returned to court with DNA analysis linking Ullrich to nine bags of blood seized in the Puerto case,<ref name="stern.de 2007">{{cite web | title="Muss ein Vampir gewesen sein" | website=stern.de | date=3 April 2007 | url=https://www.stern.de/sport/sportwelt/jan-ullrich-belastet--muss-ein-vampir-gewesen-sein--3362680.html | language=de | access-date=15 November 2022}}</ref><ref name="DER SPIEGEL 2010">{{cite web | title=Radsport: Ullrich droht neues Verfahren | website=[[Der Spiegel]] | date=14 August 2010 | url=https://www.spiegel.de/sport/sonst/radsport-ullrich-droht-neues-verfahren-a-711821.html | language=de | access-date=15 November 2022}}</ref><ref name="DER SPIEGEL 2010_2">{{cite web | title=Radsport: Ullrich verliert Klage gegen Dopingjäger | website=[[Der Spiegel]] | date=13 August 2010 | url=https://www.spiegel.de/sport/sonst/radsport-ullrich-verliert-klage-gegen-dopingjaeger-a-711657.html | language=de | access-date=15 November 2022}}</ref> and eventually after four years, Franke won the case.<ref name="Zeitung 2022" />

==Works==
===Cell biology===
Franke is author and co-author of {{circa}} 660 original articles in the field of cell and molecular biology.<ref name="CV" /> {{as of|2022}}, his [[h-index]] is 158, according to [[Google scholar]].<ref>{{Google scholar id}}</ref>

* {{cite journal | last1=Wiedenmann | first1=Bertram | last2=Franke | first2=Werner W. | title=Identification and localization of synaptophysin, an integral membrane glycoprotein of Mr 38,000 characteristic of presynaptic vesicles | journal=Cell | publisher=Elsevier BV | volume=41 | issue=3 | year=1985 | issn=0092-8674 | doi=10.1016/s0092-8674(85)80082-9 | pages=1017–1028| pmid=3924408 | s2cid=27796276 }}
* {{cite journal | last1=Franke | first1=W W | last2=Schmid | first2=E | last3=Osborn | first3=M | last4=Weber | first4=K | title=Different intermediate-sized filaments distinguished by immunofluorescence microscopy. | journal=Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences | volume=75 | issue=10 | year=1978 | issn=0027-8424 | doi=10.1073/pnas.75.10.5034 | pages=5034–5038| pmid=368806 | pmc=336257 | bibcode=1978PNAS...75.5034F | doi-access=free }}
